title.zh: 更換火星塞
title.en: Replace Spark Plugs

intro.zh: 最適合第一次動手的工作：不用頂車、不用放油，只要拆飾蓋和考爾就看得到火星塞。做完你會懂「對角鬆、分段鎖、扭力扳手」這些以後每個工作都用得到的習慣。
intro.en: The best first job: no lifting, no draining, just the cover and coils and you can see the plugs. You will learn the habits every later job needs: loosen in a pattern, tighten in stages, use a torque wrench.

title.zh: 引擎完全冷卻，拔掉電瓶負極（選擇性）
title.en: Let the engine cool fully; optionally disconnect the battery negative

note.zh: 熱的鋁缸頭拆火星塞容易拉牙。
note.en: Removing plugs from a hot aluminium head risks stripping the threads.

title.zh: 拆引擎飾蓋
title.en: Remove the engine cover

note.zh: 往上拉就脫離橡膠卡座，不用工具也行。
note.en: It pulls straight up off rubber grommets; no tools needed.

title.zh: 拆四個點火線圈（考爾）
title.en: Remove the four ignition coils

note.zh: 先拔插頭再鬆固定螺絲；考爾照缸號排好，不要混。
note.en: Unplug first, then the retaining bolt; keep the coils in cylinder order.

warning.zh: 考爾的橡膠套老化會黏在火星塞上，直直往上拔，不要扭。
warning.en: The rubber boot can stick to the plug; pull straight up, do not twist.

title.zh: 用氣槍吹掉火星塞孔周圍的砂石
title.en: Blow debris out of the plug wells

note.zh: 火星塞一鬆，孔裡的砂石會掉進燃燒室。
note.en: Anything in the well falls into the cylinder once the plug is loose.

title.zh: 拆四顆火星塞
title.en: Remove the four spark plugs

note.zh: 用有磁吸或橡膠套的火星塞套筒，拆下來看電極顏色：淡褐色正常、黑色太濃、白色太稀或過熱。
note.en: Use a magnetic or rubber-insert plug socket. Read the electrodes: light tan is normal, black is rich, white is lean or hot.

title.zh: 檢查新火星塞型號與間隙
title.en: Check the new plugs' part number and gap

note.zh: N20 原廠火星塞型號與間隙待查證；用規格書上的值，不要憑感覺調。
note.en: The N20 plug type and gap are unverified here; use the spec sheet, do not guess.

title.zh: 裝新火星塞，先用手鎖到底再上扭力
title.en: Fit the new plugs by hand, then torque

note.zh: 用手轉到底才接扭力扳手；轉不動就是歪牙，退出來重來。
note.en: Run them all the way in by hand before the torque wrench; if it binds, it is cross-threaded, so back out and restart.

warning.zh: 扭力值待查證，裝回前查原廠資料。
warning.en: Torque unverified; check the official figure before refitting.

title.zh: 裝回考爾並接插頭
title.en: Refit the coils and plug them in

title.zh: 裝回引擎飾蓋
title.en: Refit the engine cover

title.zh: 發動，確認怠速平順、沒有故障燈
title.en: Start the engine and check for a smooth idle and no warning light

note.zh: 有抖動通常是某個考爾插頭沒插到底。
note.en: A misfire now is usually a coil connector not fully home.

title.zh: 更換機油與機油濾芯
title.en: Engine Oil & Filter Change

intro.zh: N20 的機濾在引擎上方，先換濾芯讓濾座的油流回油底殼，再從車底放油。
intro.en: The N20 filter sits on top of the engine: change it first so the housing drains into the sump, then drain from underneath.

title.zh: 引擎微溫（不燙手），車頂起架好頂車架
title.en: Engine warm but not hot; lift the car and set it on stands

warning.en: Never rely on the jack alone.

title.zh: 拆機油濾芯蓋與濾芯
title.en: Remove the filter cap and element

note.zh: 蓋子的 O 型環一定換新。先拆濾芯，濾座裡的油才會流回油底殼。
note.en: Always fit the new O-ring. Removing the filter first lets the housing drain into the sump.

title.zh: 拆引擎底護板
title.en: Remove the engine undertray

title.zh: 放油：鬆油底殼放油螺絲，接油盤
title.en: Drain: undo the sump plug into a drain pan

note.zh: 放油螺絲墊片一次性；放油時間至少 10 分鐘。
note.en: The sump plug washer is single-use; let it drain at least 10 minutes.

warning.zh: 放油螺絲扭力待查證：FCP Euro 寫「最大 8 Nm」，其他網站寫 25 Nm，來源互相矛盾，所以不填數字。鎖太緊會拉壞油底殼的牙。
warning.en: Sump plug torque unverified: FCP Euro says "max 8 Nm", other sites say 25 Nm. The sources disagree, so no number is given. Overtightening strips the sump thread.

title.zh: 裝新濾芯、新 O 型環，鎖回濾芯蓋
title.en: Fit the new element and O-ring, refit the cap

title.zh: 鎖回放油螺絲（新墊片）與底護板
title.en: Refit the sump plug (new washer) and the undertray

title.zh: 加油到規定量，發動 30 秒後熄火，等 5 分鐘再看油位
title.en: Fill to spec, run 30 s, wait 5 min, then check the level

note.zh: N20 沒有機油尺，油位看 iDrive / 儀表板（要熱車）。容量社群資料約 4.5 L（FCP Euro）；機油規格待查證。
note.en: The N20 has no dipstick; read the level in iDrive / the cluster with the engine warm. Capacity is about 4.5 L per FCP Euro (community); oil grade unverified.

title.zh: 用診斷電腦或 iDrive 歸零保養提醒
title.en: Reset the service reminder via iDrive or a diagnostic tool

title.zh: 更換前煞車來令片
title.en: Replace Front Brake Pads

intro.zh: 只做左前輪示範，右邊一樣。重點：卡鉗不能吊在油管上、活塞要推回、新片要磨合。
intro.en: Shown on the left front; the right is the same. Key points: never hang the caliper by its hose, push the piston back, bed the new pads in.

title.zh: 鬆輪圈螺絲一圈，再頂車架好
title.en: Crack the wheel bolts, then lift and set on stands

title.zh: 拆左前輪
title.en: Remove the left front wheel

title.zh: 打開煞車油壺蓋，看油位
title.en: Open the fluid reservoir and check the level

note.zh: 推回活塞時油會回流到油壺，太滿會溢出。
note.en: Pushing the piston back sends fluid up to the reservoir; if it is full it overflows.

title.zh: 拆卡鉗（來令片一起下來），用鐵絲吊好
title.en: Remove the caliper (pads come with it) and hang it on wire

warning.zh: 不要讓卡鉗掛在煞車油管上。
warning.en: Do not let the caliper hang by the brake hose.

title.zh: 拆舊來令片，清潔支架滑道，檢查導銷
title.en: Take out the old pads, clean the carrier and check the guide pins

note.zh: 導銷要能順暢滑動，卡住會單邊磨損。
note.en: The pins must slide freely; a seized pin wears one pad.

title.zh: 把活塞推回，裝新片與磨耗感知線
title.en: Push the piston back, fit the new pads and wear sensor

title.zh: 裝回卡鉗，鎖導銷螺絲
title.en: Refit the caliper and torque the guide pin bolts

title.zh: 裝回輪子，放下車後對角鎖扭力
title.en: Refit the wheel; lower the car and torque in a star pattern

note.zh: 輪圈螺絲扭力待查證（一般約 120–140 Nm）。

title.zh: 發動前先踩幾下煞車踏板到硬，再試車磨合
title.en: Pump the pedal firm before driving, then bed the pads in

warning.zh: 沒踩硬就開出去，第一腳會沒有煞車。
warning.en: If you drive off without pumping, the first brake application does nothing.

title.zh: 更換電瓶（含註冊）
title.en: Replace the Battery (with registration)

intro.zh: BMW 換電瓶比別的車多一步：換完要用診斷電腦「註冊」，電腦才知道電瓶是新的。
intro.en: BMW adds one step other cars lack: after fitting, the new battery must be registered with a diagnostic tool so the car knows it is new.

title.zh: 打開行李廂，掀起右側地板與飾板
title.en: Open the boot and lift the right floor and trim

note.zh: 模擬器裡用「拆行李廂蓋」代表打開；實車只要打開。
note.en: The simulator removes the lid to represent opening it; on the car you just open it.

title.zh: 先拆負極，再拆正極，再拆固定壓板與通氣管
title.en: Negative off first, then positive, then the clamp and vent hose

warning.zh: 順序反了，扳手碰到車身會短路。
warning.en: The wrong order lets a spanner short the positive to the body.

title.zh: 取出電瓶（IBS 跟著負極線留在車上）
title.en: Lift the battery out (the IBS stays with the negative lead)

note.zh: 電瓶約 20 kg（待查證），彎腰小心。

title.zh: 放入新電瓶：同容量、同類型（AGM）
title.en: Fit the new battery: same capacity and type (AGM)

note.zh: 接通氣管；先接正極、後接負極。
note.en: Connect the vent hose; positive on first, negative last.

title.zh: 裝回飾板與地板
title.en: Refit the trim and floor

title.zh: 用診斷電腦執行「電瓶更換註冊」
title.en: Run "battery replacement registration" with a diagnostic tool

warning.zh: 不註冊，充電策略會照舊電瓶跑，新電瓶壽命縮短。
warning.en: Without registration the charging strategy stays tuned for the old battery and the new one ages early.

title.zh: 更換空氣濾芯
title.en: Replace the Air Filter

intro.zh: 十五分鐘的工作，但能順便看懂空氣從哪裡進渦輪。
intro.en: A fifteen-minute job that also shows you where air enters the turbo.

title.zh: 鬆空濾盒上蓋的卡扣或螺絲，掀開
title.en: Undo the airbox lid clips or screws and lift it

note.zh: 模擬器裡整個空濾盒會下來；實車只掀上蓋。
note.en: The simulator removes the whole box; on the car only the lid lifts.

title.zh: 取出舊濾芯，看髒的那一面
title.en: Take out the old element and look at the dirty side

note.zh: 濾芯有方向性，記住哪一面朝外。
note.en: The element is directional; note which side faces out.

title.zh: 擦乾淨盒內，不要用氣槍往進氣管吹
title.en: Wipe the box clean; never blow compressed air toward the inlet

title.zh: 放入新濾芯
title.en: Fit the new element

title.zh: 蓋回上蓋，確認密合
title.en: Refit the lid and check it seals all round
